result.rationale: The diff shows `Topic.transaction do ... PostCreator.new(...).create ... end` in TopicEmbed.import. In Rails, an inner `transaction` block (e.g., inside PostCreator) without `requires_new: true` joins the outer transaction, so an `ActiveRecord::Rollback` raised inside it does not roll back the already-created topic, which then gets committed by the outer transaction. This is the standard Rails nested-transaction pitfall and matches the code shown; the exact behavior of PostCreator's internals is not fully visible in the diff, so confidence is moderate.
